description: Find Instagram accounts by a keyword: each account's username, name and link, the most relevant first, one page. The search answers from a search index, so it gives no counts: call `instagram/profile` with a username for the whole account. Use this to find creators and brands when you do not have a username. Costs 3 credits, cached or not; a failed call is refunded.

fresh.description: Skip the cache and fetch now. Charged normally. Not available on trial credits — buy any pack to unlock it.

limit.description: At most this many results, 1–50. A page can hold fewer while `next_cursor` is set: read until it is null.

query.description: Words to search for, e.g. "sourdough bakery".

name: search_instagram_accounts
title: Search Instagram accounts
